top_signals.title: Gatwick and Heathrow warn of delays after air traffic control meltdown
top_signals.summary: Airports including Gatwick and Heathrow have warned of further delays as they work to clear a backlog of flights following disruption to the country’s traffic control system yesterday. Both of the London hubs said flights had resumed on Wednesday but warned of longer wait times and urged passengers to check if their flights were going [...]
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Apollo's Kleinman Says Legacy Portfolio Firms Have a Valuation Issue
top_signals.summary: Apollo Asset Management co-President Scott Kleinman discusses the US economy, the rising cost of capital and why he sees valuation issues for legacy portfolio companies impacting returns. He speaks with Bloomberg's Guy Johnson from the sidelines of the IPEM conference in Paris. (Source: Bloomberg)
